Description:
Operational risks arise from internal
processes, people, systems, or
external events that can disrupt
business operations. These risks
can impact efficiency, profitability,
and business continuity. For a
company like TransCentury PLC,
which operates in infrastructure
investment, energy, transport, and
manufacturing, operational risks
are particularly significant due to its
reliance on complex supply chains,
and high-value projects.
Mitigation strategies:
This risk is managed by:
• Regular safety training and
compliance audits.
• Clear policies and procedures to
ensure gaps are noted
• The Executive Board monitors and
reviews key performance indicators
through staff surveys, external data
analysis, and regular client feedback
to drive continuous improvement.
• Continued practical focus on
building people engagement and
supporting retention.
